default.title: Obtain the Sinner
default.text: The Dao of Heaven is ever constant... I wait here... for you are... the only variable... unforetold in my divination... Can you... bring hope for survival... when death is certain?

default.title: Raise to Phase 1
default.text: What grace... The hexagrams align, and a faint light is ahead.

default.title: Raise to Phase 3
default.text: The coins have fallen... Neither life nor death has been predicted... Only the Way of Heaven echoes...

default.title: Level Start
default.text: The hexagrams are favorable enough. Proceed with patience and not haste.

default.title: Victory
default.text: ...With thorough discernment comes flawless deduction.

default.title: Lose Battles
default.text: Fate... cannot be defied...

default.title: Ultimate Skill
default.text: When the celestial wheel turns, the cosmos answers its force.

default.title: Die in Battles
default.text: All possibilities have been accounted for, yet the thrust of fate is inevitable...

default.title: Greeting
default.text: ...The sky is restless today. Should you be free, do join me in a divination session.

default.title: Conversation 1
default.text: I am not starving myself... merely abstaining from desire. Even when the body is empty... the heart must not waver... My friend... do not worry.

default.title: Conversation 2
default.text: The visitor in my dream... resembled my master, though it was a mere impostor. The abyss... assumed my master's form... reflecting both my heart... and the tribulations that awaited me.

default.title: Conversation 3
default.text: All of my fellow disciples... met their calamity. I calculated every possible fate... and foresaw the ending... yet I alone... fell outside the divination... powerless to turn the tide.

default.title: Special Conversation 1
default.text: Small and light though this coin may be... it has the power to warn, to awaken, and to change... My friend... take good care of it.

default.title: Special Conversation 2
default.text: My body has already fallen into corruption... Only this resolve remains... binding me... keeping me away from that forbidden line...

default.title: Special Conversation 3
default.text: I have witnessed many people... reach their journey's end... and I have calculated... my own final destination. Yet you... pointed out the flaw of this thinking... The meaning... lies in the path I've trodden.

default.title: Full Compliance
default.text: I have always reserved my attention only for the Way of Heaven, never the minds of people. Lives come and go... nothing more than another exercise of deduction. But traveling with you has made me understand... that a heart's flame, though faint, may one day still burn bright.

default.title: Idle
default.text: This brief pause in the turning of the wheel... feels almost like a dream of days long gone.

default.title: Annoyed
default.text: ...Be still. Should the coins fall out of order, the reckoning of fate may go awry as well.

default.title: Special Attention
default.text: ...I have always preferred to just observe. Yet where you are concerned... I cannot simply stand aside. Allow me... to attempt a slight intervention.

default.title: Dispatch
default.text: Treading the path of fate... one reads the stars... and seeks answers in the hexagrams...

default.title: Dispatch Complete
default.text: ...The divination is complete. Its revelation may serve in times to come.

default.title: Level Up
default.text: The blessing lingers... All shall fall into place...

default.title: Pat Head
default.text: The long forgotten... warmth of the living...
